cohort: 701 women with severe pre-eclampsia undergoing caesarean section
finding: General anaesthesia was associated with more adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes than spinal anaesthesia in women undergoing caesarean section for severe pre-eclampsia.
mod_finding: This study found that general anesthesia for cesarean section in women with severe pre-eclampsia was associated with more negative outcomes compared to spinal anesthesia.
birth_weight: Neonates born from women in the general anaesthesia group had a higher incidence of lower birth weight.
